highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 delivers Skia m152, Graphite GPU bindings, and safer pixel and native-object lifetimes.
highlights_body: It adds backend-neutral asynchronous pixel reads, restores the Vulkan Silk.NET package, and updates native assets across supported platforms.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome m152 and includes subsequent m151 and m152 stability and servicing fixes.
Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
SKImage and SKSurface now offer backend-neutral RequestReadPixels support for asynchronous pixel readback.

bullets.lead: Native object and pixel-source lifetimes corrected
bullets.detail: Fixes use-after-free paths in SKRegion iteration and SKPixmap subset operations, plus a raster-image pixel-buffer leak on creation failure.

bullets.lead: Runtime-effect uniform buffers are replaced safely
bullets.detail: Resetting SKRuntimeEffectUniforms now disposes the prior uniform buffer.

bullets.lead: HarfBuzz blob conversion no longer leaks stream assets
bullets.detail: Converting non-memory-backed streams to HarfBuzz blobs now releases the native stream asset.
Restores the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and expands Vulkan validation to Android and Linux.
Adds Apple native symbol packages, makes Android symbol identity deterministic, and provides FreeType font support for Nano Server.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Improved native Windows build environment initialization
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced the Skia m152 engine, Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and lifetime fixes.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 completed platform packaging, HarfBuzz, performance, and upstream engine servicing work.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates HarfBuzzSharp packaging and documentation, improves shaping and tag-formatting performance, and fixes stream-backed blob lifetime handling.
